knobs.name: busy_skip

L5-1: event framTester.RequestReturned(op=READ, client=1, offset=0x030000, length=64, status=BUSY) count == 1
event framDriver.RequestRejected(op=READ, client=1, offset=0x030000, length=64, status=BUSY) count == 1
event framTester.VerifyDone(client=1, offset=0x030000, length=64, status=OK) count == 1

knobs.mechanism: harness BURST mode SEQUENTIAL issues the second read from inside the first read's completion instead of back-to-back (FPP enum FramTester.BurstMode: BACK_TO_BACK | SEQUENTIAL)

knobs.name: corrupt_block

L2-1: event framTester.VerifyDone(client=0, offset=0, length=64, status=OK, mismatches=0) count == 1
L2-2: event framTester.VerifyDone(client=0, offset=0x3FFC0, length=64, status=OK, mismatches=0) count == 1
L3-1: event framTester.VerifyDone(client=0, offset=0x020000, length=64, status=OK, mismatches=0) count == 1

knobs.mechanism: harness overwrites the test's 64-byte block with seed+7 (WRITE_PATTERN from client 1) between the planned write and the verify — inside the window for L2-1/L2-2 (hence the WritesCompleted delta also fails); for L3-1 issued right after MARK(71), before the reset, i.e. in window R (outside W1/W2; no ripple to L7-1, whose region 0x3FF00.. is rewritten by L7-1 itself)

knobs.name: final_wrong_image

knobs.mechanism: harness writes the final region with seed 0xF1F2 while the plan's dump expectation stays 0xF1F1 (device content disturbed; final-state row expected FAIL)

knobs.name: short_sweep
knobs.mechanism: harness configures SWEEP over 4095 chunks and still expects the full device

knobs.name: verify_wrong_seed

knobs.mechanism: harness verifies (READ_VERIFY / SWEEP verify pass) against seed+1 while the device holds the planned seed; BytesVerified counts bytes compared, so its delta predicates still hold
